description:
## Summary

A user filter feature was added to the RecentChatsQuickAccess component, allowing users to filter recent chats by selecting a specific user. The filter displays all chats from any project where the selected user appears (as a participant, message author, or chat creator), rather than limiting results to the active project. The implementation includes a dropdown user selector with options for the current user and other available users, plus a clear filter button. Visual indicators show when a filter is active in both collapsed and expanded modes. The feature maintains backward compatibility by showing chats from the active project only when no user filter is selected.

messages.content: Recent chats quick access will have a "user" filter and show chats from any project where the user appears
